messages:
incident-bot: Pager — Sev2: Enterprise customer 'Orion' reporting >6% websocket resets for vpc-us-west dedicated pool (app-proxy reset codes: ECONNRESET, 1006). Alert window: 3m.

jordan.b: I'm on it, taking lead. paging infra and runtime.

marta.k: @jordan.b copying logs now, looks like a burst of simultaneous reconnects from their gateway, client p99 connection duration drops to ~200ms then reset.

oncall-rt: Paging infra team (ops-tilly) for capacity/limits. Could be per-tenant connection throttling kicking in.

ops-tilly: I see a spike on the dedicated pool for tenant orion: conn_count jumped from 120 to 480 in ~90s, conn_limit is 400. We're hitting the soft limit and starting to reject.

jordan.b: Quick mitigation: raise per-tenant soft limit and enable short-term burst capacity for that pool, then isolate orion traffic to a draining node to prevent noisy neighbors.

eng-runtime: Suggested commands to adjust routing/burst temporarily:```bash
# increase tenant conn limit
redwoodctl vpc tenant update --tenant orion --conn-soft-limit 800
# enable burst capacity on pool id dp-43
redwoodctl pool update --id dp-43 --burst-capacity 2
```

marta.k: Applied the conn limit bump and enabled burst on dp-43, monitoring. No immediate spike in rejects but still seeing resets from their app-proxy (~1.8% now).

cs-lee: I'm notifying Orion support with a short blurb: "We observed transient websocket resets; we've increased your connection limit and enabled burst capacity. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with logs and recommended client backoff."

jordan.b: Next step: isolate by moving orion to a dedicated node set with stricter rate-limiting to test if issue is tenant-local. Initiating migration now (will be a rolling project, ~90s per node).

ops-tilly: Migration started — moving 1/4 nodes. Watch for tail latencies.

marta.k: While migrating, I pulled correlating app-proxy logs from Orion — they have a retry storm on reconnect without jitter. Recommend suggesting exponential backoff on their side. Sample:```json
{"client_id":"orion-proxy-11","event":"reconnect_attempt","retry_count":5,"backoff_ms":100}
```

eng-runtime: If client-side fix will take time, we can also enable server-side jittered accept window to smooth bursts (config knob: `tenant.accept_jitter_ms`). Will coordinate a short rollout.

jordan.b: Agreed. Do both: enable accept_jitter_ms=250 for orion and ask CS to push retry guidelines. After migration completes we'll reassess.

onsite (ops-tilly): Migration finished. Observed drop in resets to 0.4% post-migration + jitter enabled.

cs-lee: Orion acknowledges and will deploy retry jitter in their next patch. They've asked for postmortem and recommended rate limits to avoid future disruptions.

jordan.b: Wrapping up: incident-> mitigation successful, customer impact reduced to minor; will keep monitoring for 2h and then close. Assigning follow-up to @marta.k for postmortem and @cs-lee to coordinate customer comms. :white_check_mark:
